<b>症狀</b> 更新、下載 OCR 語言檔、或連 LLM / SSO 時憑證: Symptom　Certificate verification fails during an upgrade, while downloading OCR language files, or when connecting to an LLM / SSO.
<b>原因</b> 公司的 TLS 檢查代理把外部憑證換成自家 CA，而 Pyt: Cause　A corporate TLS-inspection proxy replaces external certificates with its own CA, which Python and uv do not trust by default.

If it still fails, import the corporate CA into the OS trust store; JTDT_TLS_INSECURE=1 bypasses verification temporarily (only on a network you trust).
<b>症狀</b> <code>jtdt update</code> 說找不到: Symptom　jtdt update says git is missing, or that this is not a git repository.
<b>原因</b> 機器上沒有 git 時，一行安裝會改走下載壓縮檔那條路，\n: Cause　Without git on the machine, the one-line installer falls back to downloading an archive, so the installation has no .git.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 裝上 git 之後重跑一次一行安裝指令 —— 它會<b>原: What to do　Install git and run the one-line installer again — it adopts the existing directory into a git repository (your .venv and data are kept), after which updates work normally.
Windows 找不到 git，或說要用 winget 安裝: Windows cannot find git, or asks you to install it with winget
<b>症狀</b> 剛裝完 git 還是找不到；或 Windows Server: Symptom　git was just installed but still cannot be found; or Windows Server has no winget.
<b>原因</b> 剛安裝的程式只更新登錄檔裡的 PATH，<b>已經開著的終端: Cause　A freshly installed program only updates PATH in the registry — terminals that are already open (including new tabs) still see the old one; and Windows Server 2019 / 2022 ship without winget.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 直接再跑一次即可，<b>不必重開機</b> —— 程式會依: What to do　Simply run it again — no reboot needed: the program looks in PATH, then the registry, then the standard install locations. On Server editions, download the installer from the git website.
<b>症狀</b> 用安裝程式裝到既有安裝上時失敗；無介面安裝還會像卡住不動。: Symptom　Installing over an existing installation fails; a silent install appears to hang.
<b>原因</b> 服務還跑著，<code>python.exe</code>: Cause　The service is still running and python.exe holds the virtual environment's files open, so they cannot be deleted. Older failure dialogs had no silent-mode default, so they waited for a button nobody could press.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.37 起已修（安裝前先停服務並等行程真的放掉檔: What to do　Fixed in v1.15.37 (the service is stopped and its handles released before anything is deleted, and every dialog has a silent default). If it hangs, stop the service manually first; the installer's own log is at C:\ProgramData\jt-doc-tools\Logs\installer.log.
升級時磁碟空間不足: Not enough disk space during an upgrade
<b>症狀</b> 備份階段失敗，而且服務已經停掉了。: Symptom　The backup step fails — and the service has already been stopped.
<b>原因</b> 升級前會完整備份資料目錄並保留三份。: Cause　Upgrades take a full backup of the data directory and keep three of them.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.17 起<b>在停服務之前</b>就先檢查空間: What to do　From v1.15.17 the space is checked before the service stops, and the message says how much is missing; the backup also skips anything that rebuilds itself (the company-ID database, temporary files, job results) — measured 1.93 → 0.56 GB per backup. Free up space and run it again.
<b>症狀</b> 用 <code>sudo</code> 跑過某個 CLI 指: Symptom　After running a CLI command with sudo, the service can no longer write to the database.
<b>原因</b> 以 root 執行時新建出來的檔案屬於 root，而服務是用: Cause　Files created while running as root belong to root, while the service runs under its own account. The easiest one to hit is jtdt reset-password — the rescue command locks you out.
<b>怎麼辦</b> v1.15.16 起所有 CLI 指令結束時都會把資料目錄: What to do　From v1.15.16 every CLI command restores ownership of the data directory when it finishes. On older versions, fix the ownership by hand (Linux: sudo chown -R jtdt:jtdt <data directory>).

<b>原因</b> 反向代理把 <code>X-Forwarded-Proto<: Cause　The reverse proxy sets X-Forwarded-Proto to a fixed https while the site is actually http — so the backend marks cookies Secure and the browser drops them over plain http. http://localhost is a secure-origin exception, which is why it cannot be reproduced on the server itself.

「連不上 JTLW」或「連 JTLW 逾時」: “Cannot reach the speech service” or a connection timeout
<b>症狀</b> 語音服務設定頁按「測試連線」失敗；辨識模式的下拉顯示\n: Symptom　“Test the connection” fails on the speech service settings page; the recognition profile dropdown shows “Could not read the list: Cannot reach the speech service”; or submitting a recording fails.
<b>原因</b> 送件位址填錯（主機、埠、<code>http</code>: Cause　The endpoint is wrong (host, port, http or https), a firewall is in the way, or their service is down. It can also be certificate verification: when they use a self-signed certificate, the connection is refused at the TLS step, and the screen still only says it cannot reach them.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 送件位址照對方給的整串貼（例：<code>https://: What to do　Paste the endpoint exactly as they gave it (for example https://host:8790/api/v1). On the machine running this system, try curl https://host:8790/api/v1/health: if it cannot connect, the problem is the network or the address; if it only connects with -k, the problem is the certificate. Paste their certificate (PEM) into “Their certificate”, and save only after checking it against the SHA-256 fingerprint they publish. Do not work around it by turning verification off: every submission hands over the API key, and with verification off anyone can impersonate them.
「對方不接受我們這台的位址 —— 請管理員把『錄音檔對外位址』給對方加進允許清單: “The speech service does not accept this machine's address. Ask your administrator to add the public address for recordings to its allow list.”
<b>症狀</b> 送出錄音後失敗，訊息結尾附著一個主機名稱。: Symptom　Submitting a recording fails, and the message ends with a host name.
<b>原因</b> 語音服務只從允許清單上的位址拉錄音檔，而本系統的「錄音檔對外: Cause　The speech service only fetches recordings from addresses on its allow list, and this system's audio base address is not on it.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 把訊息結尾的那個主機名稱交給語音服務的管理員加進允許清單。: What to do　Give the host name at the end of the message to the speech service administrator to add to the allow list. If you change the audio base address, ask them to add the new one too: the same system may be reachable both directly on the internal network and through a reverse proxy, and whichever one you fill in is the one they see.
「對方連不到我們的錄音檔位址」或「網址已經過期」: “Could not reach our recording URL” or “the link had already expired”
<b>原因</b> 錄音檔不是本系統推過去的，是<b>對方回頭來拉</b>：本系: Cause　The recording is not pushed to them; they come back and fetch it. This system hands them a short-lived signed URL (/api/speech/audio/…?exp=…&sig=…, no sign-in, expires by itself). If the audio base address is a name only the browser machine can reach (such as localhost), a firewall or reverse proxy is in the way, or the reverse proxy puts a sign-in in front, they cannot fetch it.
「會議錄音轉逐字稿」是反灰的，或顯示「還沒設定語音服務（JTLW）」: Meeting recording to transcript is greyed out, or says “The speech service is not set up yet”
<b>症狀</b> 側欄與首頁的那支工具點不下去；打開工具頁只看到一句設定提示。: Symptom　The tool cannot be opened from the sidebar or the home page; opening its page only shows a setup notice.
<b>原因</b> 這支工具依賴外部的語音服務，管理區沒有啟用、或送件位址與金鑰: Cause　The tool depends on an external speech service. While it is not enabled in the admin area, or the endpoint and API key are incomplete, it stays greyed out on purpose, so there is never an upload box that looks normal and only fails after you press it.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 到管理區「語音服務（JTLW）」勾選啟用，填好送件位址、A: What to do　In the admin area, open Speech service (JTLW), tick enable, fill in the endpoint, API key and audio base address, press “Test the connection”, then save. The other 49 tools are not affected.
「JTLW 不接受這把金鑰（401）」或「沒有這個動作的權限（403）」: “The speech service rejected this API key (401)” or “it lacks permission for this action (403)”
<b>症狀</b> 「測試連線」或送件時出現其中一句。: Symptom　One of these appears when testing the connection or submitting.
<b>原因</b> 這兩個是不同的狀況。<b>401</b>：金鑰打錯、被對方撤: Cause　These are two different situations. 401: the key is mistyped, was revoked on their side, or was pasted as a whole header. 403: the key is correct, but it does not have permission for this action; checking for typos or revocation will not find anything. Their health check cannot reveal either, because it does not check the key; that is why “Test the connection” also asks once with the key.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 401：「API 金鑰」只貼金鑰本身（對方給的那一串；\n: What to do　401: put only the key itself in “API key” (the string they gave you; this system builds the Authorization: Bearer header itself, and a pasted prefix is removed automatically), and if it is still rejected, ask them to confirm the key is still valid. 403: ask their administrator to grant the key the permission; which one is missing is written to this system's service log (jtdt logs).
<b>症狀</b> 送出錄音後失敗，訊息是「對方連不到我們的錄音檔位址」、\n: Symptom　Submitting a recording fails with “The speech service could not reach our recording URL”, “The link had already expired when the speech service came to fetch the recording”, or “We rejected the speech service when it came to fetch the recording (401 / 403)”.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 「錄音檔對外位址」要填<b>從語音服務那台連得到</b>的: What to do　Fill in an audio base address that is reachable from the speech service machine (the settings page never derives it from the browser address; guessing wrong would make it work for some people and not others). If the reverse proxy puts SSO, Kerberos or another sign-in in front, let /api/speech/audio/ through; it is already protected by the signature. An expired link is not caused by queueing: they fetch the file as soon as the job arrives and never fetch that URL again, however long it waits. It usually means retrying or waiting too long before submitting; submit again.
「JTLW 回報成功，但一段逐字稿都沒有」: “The speech service reported success but returned no transcript segments”
<b>症狀</b> 轉逐字稿失敗，訊息是這一句；錄音裡明明有人講話。: Symptom　Transcription fails with this message, even though people clearly speak in the recording.
<b>原因</b> 語音服務在把辨識結果傳回來的途中重啟過（更新或當機），傳到一: Cause　The speech service restarted (an update or a crash) while sending the recognition result back, and a partial result was taken as complete, most often with no segments at all. This system always treats zero segments as a failure; it never hands over an empty transcript as a success.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 重新送一次通常就好。一直發生的話，請語音服務那側確認伺服器: What to do　Submitting again usually works. If it keeps happening, ask the speech service side whether the server is being updated or restarted.
「語音服務不接受這個語言設定」: “The speech service does not accept this language setting”
<b>症狀</b> 選了某個語言，一送出就失敗。: Symptom　After choosing a language, the job fails as soon as it is submitted.
<b>原因</b> 語音服務只收目前辨識模式支援的語言。v1.16.8 以前頁面: Cause　The speech service only accepts the languages its current recognition mode supports. Before v1.16.8 the page sent Chinese as zh, while the service expects zh-Hant, so every job with Chinese selected was rejected (fixed in v1.16.9). If it still happens, the recognition mode chosen by the administrator most likely does not support that language (for example, the Taiwanese mode only accepts Taiwanese and Chinese).
<b>怎麼辦</b> 改選「自動判斷」再送一次。一直發生的話，請管理員到「語音服: What to do　Choose Detect automatically and submit again. If it keeps happening, ask your administrator to check which languages the current recognition mode supports under Speech service (JTLW) (they are listed once a recognition mode is selected).
<b>錄音最後很長一段沒有字</b> 錄音最後超過一分鐘沒有任何文字時，結果頁會: A long stretch with no text at the end　When the last minute or more of a recording has no text at all, the result page says how long that gap is. Since 2026-09-23 the speech service no longer returns only the first part of a transcript, so this hint now mostly means the recording was left running, or it ends with applause or music. If people really were speaking during that time, submit again.
整場辨識成另一種語言: Recognised as the wrong language throughout
一直停在「排隊中（前面還有 N 件）」，或「等了 N 分鐘，對方還沒有回報結果: Stuck at “Queued (N ahead)”, or “Waited N minutes and the speech service has not reported a result, so the job was cancelled on their side”
<b>症狀</b> 轉逐字稿送出後一直顯示排隊中；或輪到之後處理很久，最後失敗並: Symptom　After submitting, the transcription keeps showing Queued; or once its turn comes it runs for a long time and finally fails with the message above. You may also see “The speech service queue is full; submit again later”.
<b>原因</b> 語音服務的 GPU <b>一次只處理一件、其餘排隊</b>，: Cause　The speech service GPU handles one job at a time and queues the rest, and the jobs ahead include other people's. While queued, the page shows how many are ahead, and that time does not count towards the waiting limit; once its turn comes, recognition and correction progress moves. This system only starts timing after the job's turn comes (the larger of 15 minutes and half the recording length) and asks them to cancel the job once that is exceeded; the queue itself is waited on for at most 4 hours.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 排隊中就等它輪到；很長的錄音避開別人正在送長會議的時段。\: What to do　While queued, wait for its turn; for very long recordings, avoid times when someone else is sending a long meeting. If it times out after its turn came, or queues for more than 4 hours, ask the speech service side to check the GPU server.
中文會議卻整場辨識成英文（或反過來）: A Chinese meeting recognised as English throughout (or the other way round)
<b>症狀</b> 逐字稿大部分是錯字，或整場變成另一種語言；語言選的是「自動判: Symptom　Most of the transcript is wrong characters, or the whole meeting came out in another language; the language was set to Detect automatically.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 在「語言」選整場使用的語言，再送一次。中英句子交錯的會議請: What to do　Set Language to the language used throughout the meeting and submit again. For meetings that alternate between Chinese and English sentences, pick the language used most: whole sentences in the other language are mostly not recognised correctly (English terms inside Chinese sentences are fine).
<b>原因</b> 「自動判斷」只看錄音開頭約 30 秒的講話來決定整場用哪一種: Cause　Detect automatically only listens to about the first 30 seconds of speech to decide which language to use for the whole recording. If someone speaks another language at the start (for example an English opening; 20 seconds is enough), the whole meeting is recognised in the wrong language. The speech service measured a meeting that was mostly Chinese but opened in English: the error rate on Chinese sentences went from 15% to 88%. Silence or background noise at the start does not matter, so there is no need to trim it.
Health check timed out / failed（但服務其實是好的: Health check timed out / failed (but the service is actually fine)
<b>另一種</b> 從 v1.15.11 ~ v1.16.10 更新時，最後印: Another case　Updating from v1.15.11 through v1.16.10 ends with Health check failed while Service state says RUNNING / active; on Windows it also says no log was found.
<b>原因</b> 那幾版的健康檢查本身有錯（少了一行 import），\n: Cause　The health check in those versions was itself broken (a missing import), so it reported failure whether or not the service was up. Windows and macOS also looked for the log in the wrong place.
<b>怎麼辦</b> 用瀏覽器打得開就代表更新成功，不需要處理。\n: What to do　If the page opens in a browser, the update succeeded and nothing needs fixing. Fixed in v1.16.11, but the update to v1.16.11 itself still prints this message once (the check is run by the version you are updating from); from the next update on it is gone. Where the logs actually are: Windows C:\ProgramData\jt-doc-tools\Logs\ (jtdt-svc.err.log and jtdt-svc.out.log), macOS ~/Library/Logs/ (jt-doc-tools.err and jt-doc-tools.log), Linux journalctl -u jt-doc-tools.
